title: Space Launch - Orbital Temple
heading: Space Launch
intro: On January 16, 2026, the Orbital Temple was aboard ISRO's PSLV-C62 rocket. The rocket launched successfully, but did not deploy its satellites. The Orbital Temple did not reach orbit.

status.heading: What happens now
status.paragraph1: We are working on a new launch opportunity. The date is not yet confirmed.
status.paragraph2: Temples take time to build. Some took centuries. The Orbital Temple carries the names of those who believed in it, and that commitment remains. We will try again.

partnership: The first Orbital Temple launch was a partnership between NewSpace India Limited (NSIL), a Government of India Company under Department of Space, Antrix Corporation, and the artist. This collaboration represented a significant milestone for art in space exploration, bringing together India's space program with an artistic vision of radical inclusivity. We are now exploring new launch opportunities.
